core_obligations: Replace A by a localization off p (permitted by the blowup functoriality lemma) and write kappa = R/pi R; then A/pi A is smooth over kappa at p, hence (A/pi A)_p is regular.
Choose g_1, ..., g_c in p mapping to a regular system of parameters of (A/pi A)_p; after localizing, p = (pi, g_1, ..., g_c) and pi, g_1, ..., g_c is a regular sequence in A.
The blowup has the presentation A' = A[y_1, ..., y_c]/(pi y_1 - g_1, ..., pi y_c - g_c); write the NL exact sequence for R -> A[y] -> A', where the class of pi y_i - g_i maps to -dg_i + pi dy_i.

It suffices to show dg_1, ..., dg_c form part of a basis of the finite free module Omega_{A/R, p}; by the base-change identification Omega_{A/R, p}/pi = Omega_{(A/pi A)/kappa, p} and the separability of kappa(p) over kappa, the independence follows from the computation-of-differentials lemma.
Conclude (I/I^2)_p is free on pi y_i - g_i, H_1(NL_{A'/R})_p = 0, the displayed sequence is exact with cokernel (A'/pi A')_p^{direct sum c}, and R -> A' is smooth at p'.
proof_roadmap: Localization reduction; regular parameters of the special fibre; blowup presentation; NL sequence; independence of differentials.
difficulty_reason: A five-step computation; the substance is the NL bookkeeping of the blowup presentation and the separability argument for the differentials.
